about.heading: Our Story
about.desc: AAWBA connects Asian American women and families with culturally informed health education, trusted resources and inclusive community experiences—so every person can feel informed, supported and empowered.
about.missionText: AAWBA empowers Asian American women and their families to thrive through culturally responsive health education, trusted resource navigation, meaningful community engagement, leadership development, and responsible partnerships that advance lifelong well-being and opportunity.
about.visionText: A future where every Asian American woman feels seen, heard, supported, and empowered to live a healthier life, pursue her aspirations with confidence, and create lasting positive impact for her family and community.
about.bannerP1: We combine community-led programming with partnerships across healthcare, beauty, and academic institutions — translating research and lived experience into workshops, resources, and events that are accessible in both English and Chinese.
about.bannerP2: Currently serving the greater metropolitan area with in-person programs, and reaching a nationwide audience through virtual workshops and digital resources.

hero.heading: Our Work
hero.desc: We educate, connect and help people navigate. We design programs with community needs in mind, present information in understandable and culturally responsive ways, and connect participants with qualified services when needs extend beyond our role.

pillars.heading: How we show up for the community

boundary.heading: What We Do Not Do
boundary.desc: AAWBA does not itself diagnose illness, prescribe treatment, provide psychotherapy or give individualized medical advice. Educational information is not a substitute for care from a qualified professional. Programs requiring licensure are delivered only through appropriately qualified professionals or approved partner organizations.

standards.heading: Community Standards
standards.desc: Participants are expected to communicate respectfully, protect others' privacy, avoid harassment or discrimination, refrain from giving unqualified medical advice, disclose relevant commercial interests and follow event safety instructions. AAWBA may moderate or remove content and participation that conflicts with these standards.

stories.heading: Stories and Testimonials
stories.desc: AAWBA publishes personal stories only with documented permission. Contributors may choose how they are identified and may decline the use of sensitive details. Testimonials must reflect genuine experience and may not imply guaranteed health outcomes.

hero.heading: Membership
hero.tagline: Individual Members · Honorary Members · Corporate Members · Sponsorship
hero.desc: AAWBA membership is a mission-centered community built on measurable access, trusted relationships and responsible visibility — never on selling governance rights, personal data or medical influence.

tiers.heading: Find the tier that fits you

joining.heading: How membership works
joining.text1: Individual membership is open to any adult who supports AAWBA's mission, submits accurate information and accepts our Code of Conduct. Annual memberships run twelve months from activation; renewal notices go out 30 days before expiration, with a 30-day grace period.
joining.text2: We ask all members to communicate respectfully, protect others' privacy, and refrain from unqualified medical advice or unauthorized solicitation. Membership dues, sponsorships and honorary status never confer governance voting rights — those remain with our Statutory Voting Members under the Constitution and By-Laws.
